purpose: Exploration only; waiting for user selection before production integration

variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one original app icon concept for Aarre, a premium browser bookmark and personal knowledge collection app. The companion NexAlign icon consists of three separated stacked diamond paper planes, pure white on top, mid gray in the middle, dark gray underneath, on a black square. Match its disciplined grayscale, bold filled geometry, simple subtly dimensional folded-paper language and optical clarity, without copying the three-diamond symbol. This is an exploration asset for user choice, not a UI screen. Square 1024x1024 composition, uniform near-black #0B0C0D background extending completely to all four edges. Single centered symbol occupying about 65% of the image width and height, generous consistent margins. Only white and neutral gray flat geometric facets. Razor-clean vector-like edges. Must read clearly at 24 pixels. No text, no captions, no border, no extra enclosing tile, no star, no sparkles, no colored accent, no gradients, no realistic lighting, no cast shadow, no photorealism, no material texture.
Direction A — STACKED BOOKMARK. Two broad, parallel vertical bookmark ribbons offset diagonally like two saved pages, one front white ribbon and one rear medium-gray ribbon exposed to the upper-right. Both are solid geometric planes with one crisp V notch at the bottom. Small separation gap between layers. The front white ribbon dominates and the rear layer gives a restrained folded-paper depth like NexAlign. Broad clean silhouette, minimal path count. A memorable bookmark mark, not an outline bookmark or book illustration.

No outline or perspective grid; strong simple geometry.
